warrant: The policy compares physical-bin membership masks, region counts and float32 density thresholds; interval-buffer slot order, padding and sentinels are intentionally discarded. The approved two-binary64-ULP whole-distribution variant was still quantized away. A Linux probe measured threshold spacings of 2.9802322387695312e-8, 1.4901161193847656e-8 and 3.725290298461914e-9, so the current 1e-8 placeholder is below one ULP of the first stream and cannot be finalized. STOP 4 recommendation: whole-distribution scale by two float32 ULPs and atol 5e-7, which gives about 5.59x headroom over the measured 8.940696716308594e-8 spread while masks/counts remain exact because the bound is below one.
